choices.reason: No rule separates the candidates: neither contrast is designated primary or main, and both use the same outcome, analysis, session, and repeated task, with neither reporting participant-level standardizing statistics or representing a preferred full-sample or factorial contrast. Both AI arms are scripted, undisclosed personas under identical interaction constraints, with no documented basis for ranking either as closer to free use of a general chatbot and no reported combined-AI creativity contrast.
choices.locator: PDF p. 9, Section 3.3 (two quoted sentences); Appendix B, pp. 28-30 (persona constraints); pp. 1, 7-10, 13, 18-19 (design and analyses).
choices.quote: Both personas drew upon identical task knowledge, differing only in stance and communicative approach (Appendix B). ... These parameters were held constant across personas, ensuring that differences between conditions arose from epistemic stance rather than participation frequency.
